subject: Civic Education
competence: Broad curriculum competency standard in plain English
lesson: Expresses views accepting that the practice of such a consumption style contributes to sustainable development: Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.4.6
unique_learning_outcome: Expresses views accepting that the practice of such a consumption style contributes to sustainable development.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: As we explore the concept of sustainable consumption, let's reflect on our daily habits and how they impact our environment. Can you think of one simple change you could make to reduce your waste?

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher introduces the Sri Lankan real-world scenario, clarifies group objectives, and distributes task cards and role assignments as a facilitator.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students arrange into collaborative groups, review inquiry task cards, assign group roles, and formulate investigative questions.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Inquiry task cards, role sheets, scenario prompts

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher actively circulates among student groups, facilitates inquiry, scaffolds complex civic concepts with probing questions, and ensures active participation.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students collaborate actively in assigned roles to execute the investigation/simulation, analyzing Sri Lankan community situations without passive spectators.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Activity worksheets, observation sheets, chart paper, markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher moderates student spokesperson presentations, facilitates constructive peer evaluation, and synthesizes key student findings against syllabus outcomes.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Group spokespersons present findings and solutions; peers evaluate presentations using criteria and note constructive feedback.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_method: Spokesperson Presentation, Peer Review & Plenary Synthesis

summary: Students will create a shared civic proposal and diagram to express their views on the impact of consumption styles on sustainable development.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Formative feedback criteria: Does the group's proposal demonstrate an understanding of the concept of sustainable consumption? Is the proposal well-organized and easy to follow?
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: In-class quiz: Can you recall the main points of the group's proposal and how it relates to sustainable development?

Activity: Station Jigsaw Synthesis Matrix: Competency Level 8.4.6
Approach: Students use station jigsaw synthesis matrix to explore 'Expresses views accepting that the practice of such a consumption style contributes to sustainable development.'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (40 students): Desks arranged into 8 teams (8 teams (8 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 40 students using 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 8 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
Grouping: 8 teams (8 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
